title: Tab becomes a workspace flipper (replaces the radial on Tab)
description:
User decision 2026-07-29: Tab is worth more as a workspace flipper than as a radial trigger. Gallery <-> the last card you had open, one key, no ring, no aiming.

BEHAVIOUR (v1):
  - In the gallery, Tab opens the last-used card in this project. If the project has exactly ONE card, Tab opens that one.
  - In a card, Tab returns to the gallery.
  - Project has NO cards: Tab does nothing. Not a toast, not a flash - nothing.
  - The remembered card is PER PROJECT and must survive a restart, so it lives in project.json.
  - Remembered card no longer exists: Tab does not flip anywhere.
  - The user DELETES the remembered card: clear the entry in project.json (leave it empty rather than guessing a replacement). Tab then does nothing until the user opens a card again.

So there are exactly two write points: the user ENTERS a card history (record it) and the user DELETES a card (clear it if it was the remembered one).

PHASE 2, once the App Library un-gates (MPI-332): the gallery side of the flip becomes gallery <-> apps <-> last card. Do not build this now - just do not design v1 in a way that blocks it.

THE RADIAL. Tab is currently owned by MpiRadialMenu ('radialMenu.toggle' in hotkeyRegistry.js). The radial is NOT broken, it is degenerate: MPI-356 moved ops to the prompt box op strip, leaving RADIAL_ITEMS = [Models] for both workspace contexts, and MpiRadialMenu._onTabDown short-circuits any single-item context - fires it on key-down and never draws the ring. That is why Tab currently just opens the model picker. Taking Tab means deciding what happens to that Models shortcut and to the workspace radial contexts. Ctrl+Tab ('radialMenu.devToggle', dev-gated, 3 items) still draws a real ring and is NOT in scope. NEEDS A USER DECISION before code - see acceptance.

BLAST RADIUS mapped while carding:
  - js/managers/hotkeyRegistry.js - 'radialMenu.toggle' currently binds Tab, gated to gallery + group-history. Native Tab focus-traversal is already suppressed globally in hotkeyManager, so the flipper inherits that.
  - js/shell/navigation.js:45 RADIAL_ITEMS + :282-283 setContextItems for PAGE_GALLERY and PAGE_GROUP_HISTORY.
  - js/components/Primitives/MpiRadialMenu/MpiRadialMenu.js:374 _onTabDown (the single-item short-circuit).
  - RECORD point: every path that opens a card mounts MpiGroupHistoryBlock with a groupId prop - that is ONE choke point. navigate(PAGE_GROUP_HISTORY) has only one call site today (MpiGalleryBlock.js:205) but the Block mount is the safer hook because it also covers restore-on-boot and any future entry path.
  - CLEAR point: removeGroup has FOUR call sites (MpiGalleryBlock.js:374, :917, :1016 and MpiGroupHistoryBlock.js:2061). Do NOT patch four call sites - put the clear inside the service (projectService.removeGroup / projectModel.removeGroupFromProject) so it cannot be bypassed. A four-call-site fix on a shared primitive is a false done.
  - project.json writes from server routes MUST go through updateProjectJson() in routes/projects.js (per-file queued atomic writes), never direct fs.writeJson.
  - SCHEMA_VERSION is 4 (js/migrations/projectMigrations.js). Decide whether an OPTIONAL field with a safe absent-means-nothing default needs a bump + migration, or whether absent is simply handled on read. Check .claude/rules/versioning.md rather than assuming.
acceptance: DECIDED 2026-07-29 by the user: DROP THE WORKSPACE RADIAL ENTIRELY. Remove RADIAL_ITEMS and the PAGE_GALLERY / PAGE_GROUP_HISTORY setContextItems calls; the radial survives only as the dev-gated Ctrl+Tab ring. Models stays reachable via the PromptBox model button (which is how it is actually opened) and the existing ui:open-model-picker event, which must keep working. Do NOT invent a replacement key.
In the gallery, Tab opens the last-used card of the current project; with exactly one card in the project it opens that card
In a card, Tab returns to the gallery
A project with no cards: Tab does nothing at all - no navigation, no toast, no visible reaction
The remembered card survives an app restart (persisted in project.json, per project)
A remembered card that no longer exists does not flip anywhere and does not throw
Deleting the remembered card clears the entry and leaves it empty - Tab then does nothing until the user opens another card
The clear-on-delete lives in the projectService/projectModel removal path, NOT patched into the four removeGroup call sites
Ctrl+Tab dev radial (dev-gated) is unaffected and still draws its ring
Native Tab focus-traversal stays suppressed - Tab must never walk gallery cards or enter the slide-over
Phase 2 is NOT built: gallery <-> apps <-> card waits for the App Library to un-gate (MPI-332). v1 must not architecturally block it
